meta.title: Generations — Preserve Your Family Heritage
meta.description: Build a living record of your family's journey. Add members, define relationships, and share your tree with loved ones.

hero.headline: Discover your heritage.
hero.body: Build a living record of your family's journey. Generations provides a warm, secure space to document stories, preserve portraits, and connect across generations.

features.sectionBody: We treat your family history with the same care you do—safeguarding your memories for the next generation.

security.title: Vault-Grade Security
security.body: Your data is encrypted at rest and private by default. You control exactly who sees your tree and what information is shared with others.

collaboration.title: Collaborative Research
collaboration.body: Invite siblings, cousins, and elders to contribute. Piece together your history together without overwriting each other's work.

cta.headline: Your story is waiting to be told.
cta.body: Be among the first families to preserve their heritage with Generations.

privacy.title: A calm, private place for family history
privacy.description: Generations is designed to help families document and share their history with clear expectations around access, visibility, and account control.
privacy.sectionOneBody: Trees are intended for invited access, giving families space to add names, dates, stories, and photos without publishing them broadly.
privacy.sectionTwoBody: When a tree owner collaborates or shares a public view, that access is a deliberate action they control and can revisit later.
privacy.sectionThreeBody: Language preferences, sign-in flows, and account settings are part of the product so users can manage access and keep their records up to date.

support.title: Support for using Generations
support.description: Generations offers a straightforward product experience for creating trees, inviting collaborators, and viewing shared family history.
support.sectionOneBody: New users can create an account, start a tree, and return to the dashboard to continue adding members and relationships at their own pace.
support.sectionTwoBody: Sign-in, language preference, password, and email-verification flows are available in-product so people can recover access and manage their accounts.
support.sectionThreeBody: Support is focused on helping users understand the current product experience; this page does not open tickets, provide live chat, or promise custom workflows.
